## All spelling competencies

| Competency | Word bank (practice items, `wordbank.json`) | Journey bank (`journey-bank.json`) | Independent evidence words |

| EN.FND.SPL.inflections | 475 | 4258 | 2689 |

| EN.FND.SPL.homophones | 43 | — (not yet a journey) | 0 |

Morphological and homophone words stay in the word bank as practice items (steps: common_pairs 32, less_common 11, able_ible 60, double_at_join 60, ful_ly_ment 60, plain_affix 60, tion_sion 60). They are not yet part of the adaptive journey: the engine's rule definitions cover inflections only.
